polls.description: OpenAI's new Jalapeno chip outperforming Nvidia's hardware in benchmark tests represents a major shift in AI chip competition and could disrupt Nvidia's market dominance.
polls.question: Will OpenAI's Jalapeno chip seriously threaten Nvidia's AI dominance?

cluster_stories.title: OpenAI Says New Jalapeno Chips Outperformed Nvidia in Testing
cluster_stories.summary: OpenAI says the new Jalapeno chips performed better than Nvidia Corp.’s current lineup during testing, leading in two categories: the amount of AI work it could handle per unit of power and its speed at returning responses. OpenAI chip chief Richard Ho goes over the results with Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)
cluster_stories.headline: OPENAI'S JALAPENO CHIPS BEAT NVIDIA IN TESTING

cluster_stories.title: OpenAI Claims Its New Chips Can Outperform Nvidia Processors in Tests
cluster_stories.summary: Jalapeno chip will let OpenAI customers choose models that offer lower cost or faster answers
cluster_stories.headline: OPENAI CHIPS OUTPERFORM NVIDIA IN TESTS

cluster_stories.summary: OpenAI says its Jalapeno inference chip, developed with Broadcom, outperformed Nvidia’s GB300 on AI work per unit of power and on response speed. It was not tested against Nvidia’s newer Vera Rubin hardware and is not designed for training. OpenAI has published numbers for the chip it built to need Nvidia less. cluster_stories.headline: OPENAI'S JALAPENO CHIP CRUSHES NVIDIA GB300

cluster_stories.title: OpenAI’s Jalapeño chip is built for fast inference at scale, benchmarks show
cluster_stories.summary: Tested on SemiAnalysis’ InferenceX benchmark, Jalapeño registered both more tokens per user and more throughput per kilowatt than the currently available state-of-the art.

polls.question: Who bears more responsibility for chip smuggling to China?

cluster_stories.title: Nvidia employee charged with smuggling advanced chips into China
cluster_stories.summary: Prosecutors identify Taiwan-based manager as ‘central figure’ in scheme involving US semiconductor maker’s AI servers
cluster_stories.headline: NVIDIA EMPLOYEE CHARGED Smuggling AI Chips to China

cluster_stories.title: Taiwan indicts Nvidia manager over chips shipped to China
cluster_stories.summary: Taiwanese prosecutors have indicted a senior Nvidia manager and eight others over an alleged scheme that shipped 74 servers containing B300 chips to China via Japan and Indonesia. They are seeking five years for forgery and breach of trust. The first known criminal case against an Nvidia employee over AI chip smuggling has reached indictment. cluster_stories.headline: TAIWAN INDICTS NVIDIA MANAGER Over B300 Chip Smuggling to China

cluster_stories.title: Taiwan Indicts Nvidia Manager Following Chip Smuggling Probe
cluster_stories.summary: Taiwanese prosecutors indicted a senior Nvidia Corp. manager as part of a group that allegedly smuggled advanced AI chips into China, according to people familiar with the matter, advancing the island democracy’s first known crackdown on the black-market trade of such accelerators.
cluster_stories.headline: NVIDIA MANAGER INDICTED: Taiwan Cracks AI Chip Smuggling Ring to China
